record.question: Which one of the following statements is not accurate about Court Judgment?
options: The Engineer-in-Charge applies for and furnish a copy of the judgment and all other relevant papers, his own comments and the opinion of the Counsel conducting the case, on the advisability of filing an appeal/revision petition to enable the government to come to a decision whether an appeal/revision is filed or not.
The proposal is made well in advance of the last date of filing an appeal, and it is completed in every respect.
Superintending Engineer, on receipt of the relevant papers, sends his comments to the SDG/ ADG/CE who in turn forwards his proposal to the Ministry to enable to seek advice of the Ministry of Law.
The cost and expenses incurred on civil suits in connection with execution of Government works is charged as per the General Financial Rules.
